event.description: Replace two d14 heads with one d13 head and ff18
event.proposal: family: attention organization; current retained incumbent is 2982 parameters at 99.9700%, a +0.97 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0043, d14/h2 with ff24 at 3038/99.91%; same-family failed result: attempt-0042, tying Q and shared KV projections at 2608/10.29% (the prior d14 full-output attempt-0025 was also 9.99%); prior attempts in this family: 9. Hypothesis: d14/h2 succeeds with 7-wide head channels, but the minimum may instead use one full d13 head with a larger per-head output map and ff18, reducing the model to 2951 parameters. This is more informative than another d14 FF decrement because it changes head organization and tests whether two-head specialization is essential; the nearest untested alternative is d13/h2, which is not divisible without changing the channel geometry. Keep two layers, MQA-form K/V path, independent head-local output map, affine-free block pre-norms, final learned scale without bias, learned positions, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2982 parameters.
